question.text: The correct statement regarding the following compounds is

options.text: only I and II are chiral
only I and III are chiral

solution.text: $2-R, 3-R$ configuration, s0 it is a chiral compound $2-R, 3-S$ configuration has plane of symmetry or in other words, rotation of hall part is cancelled by the other half, so it is not a chiral compound. $2-S, 3-S$ configuration, so it is also a chiral compound.
